summary: Wellgistics Health filed an 8-K regarding a non-binding term sheet for a multi-party transaction involving acquisitions, licenses, and a controlling interest acquisition. The deal would issue convertible preferred stock representing 89.6% of common stock to counterparties; current holders retain ~10.4%. No definitive agreement exists yet. The structure resembles a reverse merger or asset roll-up with complex contingencies. A $2M concurrent investment is targeted. The filing lacks firm pricing, premium, or timeline. This is a preliminary proposal, not a binding deal. Watch for definitive documentation, shareholder dilution, and regulatory approvals.
